model.name: overview.autoRegenOnCommit
model.description: Regenerate the sprints.overview.md generated index INSIDE the commit (pre-commit hook, only when staged scenario units change) so the committed overview ALWAYS equals regen-of-committed-units BY CONSTRUCTION — killing the 3 observed T37.6 REDs (stale artifact / drift-during-work / commit-vs-write race). DISTINCT from generateOverview (which produces the content); this is the commit-time orchestration: deletion-check + guardedWriteRegion regen + shared-index safety + stub-must-fail verify + stage. Rides the R37.8 owned-output-guard family (narrative preserved byte-for-byte).
